description: This file contains unit tests for authentication endpoints of a FastAPI application, including login, registration, and logout functionalities, utilizing the TestClient for HTTP requests.

methods.name: assert_token_response(resp)
methods.description: Asserts that the response contains a valid token with expected properties.

methods.name: test_login_and_mirror(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests the login endpoint via different URL paths and verifies token response structure.

methods.name: test_register_and_mirror_idempotent(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests user registration endpoint for successful registration, idempotency, and consistency of responses.

methods.name: test_logout_if_available(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests the logout endpoint, ensuring it accepts a token and returns the expected acknowledgment.
